title: Will and Portrait
author: Yara Oyelaran
blurb: Edmund Thornbury, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
